subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should OpenClaw adopt/rework the open cross-repo fix for minute-zero cron stagger detection, or close that PR and queue a maintainer replacement?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but the only open closing PR is in a fork, is not maintainer-editable, and still needs edge-case review before it can be trusted as the landing path.

options.title: Review or replace linked PR
options.body: Review `https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1175`, ask for maintainer edits/rebase/proof if useful, or open a narrow credited replacement if adoption is faster.

options.title: Close linked PR and queue repair
options.body: Close the uneditable cross-repo PR and let ClawSweeper create a fresh focused fix PR from current main.

options.title: Defer cron stagger expansion
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not start repair until maintainers decide the exact minute-field semantics for high-frequency schedules.

recommendation.title: Review or replace linked PR
recommendation.body: Review `https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1175`, ask for maintainer edits/rebase/proof if useful, or open a narrow credited replacement if adoption is faster.

likelyOwner.reason: The original default-stagger behavior and docs trace to this owner history, making this the best available routing candidate for the helper semantics decision.
